meta.description: Agentic Trading Intelligence OS - Research Benchmark

categories.name: Trading Frameworks
categories.description: Core trading and algorithmic trading frameworks

projects.name: Freqtrade
projects.description: Free, open source crypto trading bot written in Python. Supports dry-run, backtesting, strategy optimization via hyperopt, and live trading on multiple exchanges.
key_features: Backtesting engine with realistic fee modeling
projects.relevance: HIGH - Core trading engine candidate. Proven production-grade crypto trading with strategy backtesting, live execution, and exchange integration. Its plugin architecture aligns with our monorepo modular design.

projects.name: NautilusTrader
projects.description: Production-grade, high-performance algorithmic trading platform built with Rust core and Python interface. Designed for multi-asset, multi-venue trading.
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Best-in-class execution engine. Rust core provides sub-millisecond latency. Its actor-model architecture and multi-venue support directly map to our Agentic Trading OS requirements.

projects.name: Backtrader
projects.description: Python backtesting library for trading strategies. Mature, well-documented event-driven backtesting framework with live trading support.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Classic reference architecture for event-driven backtesting. Its Cerebro orchestrator pattern and strategy abstraction are educational for our design, though it's largely unmaintained.

projects.name: Zipline
projects.description: Algorithmic trading library created by Quantopian. Event-driven backtesting engine for Python that powers the Quantopian platform. Currently community-maintained (zipline-reloaded).
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - The Pipeline API is a gold standard for factor computation. Zipline-reloaded continues community maintenance. Its factor pipeline design should inform our alpha library.

projects.name: VectorBT
projects.description: Python library for vectorized backtesting. Super-fast backtesting and analysis using NumPy/Numba for array-based strategy evaluation.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Essential for rapid strategy prototyping and parameter sweeps. Vectorized approach complements event-driven engines. Should be integrated as our fast-backtesting module.

projects.name: Jesse
projects.description: Advanced crypto trading framework written in Python. Focused on simplifying strategy research and definition with clean API and fast backtesting.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Clean strategy API design is a good reference. Its local-first approach and strategy abstraction patterns inform our developer experience design.

projects.name: Hummingbot
projects.description: Open source crypto market making and liquidity bot. Supports centralized and decentralized exchanges for market making, arbitrage, and other strategies.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Best open-source market making engine. Its connector architecture and strategy V2 framework (yield-based) directly applicable to our execution and market-making modules.

projects.name: Lean Engine (QuantConnect)
projects.description: Lean Algorithmic Trading Engine by QuantConnect. Multi-language (C#/Python) algorithmic trading engine supporting equities, FX, crypto, futures, and options.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Enterprise-grade trading platform. Its algorithm factory, universe selection, and multi-language support patterns are key references for our production architecture.

projects.name: Qlib (Microsoft)
projects.description: AI-oriented quantitative investment platform by Microsoft. Provides full pipeline from data processing to model training to portfolio management.
key_features: Built-in ML models (LightGBM, LSTM, Transformer, etc.)
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Premier AI quant platform. Its expression engine for alpha factors, model zoo, and ML pipeline directly map to our AI layer. Essential reference for our alpha and ML modules.

projects.name: PyAlgoTrade
projects.description: Mature Python algorithmic trading library with event-driven backtesting, paper trading, and live trading support.
projects.relevance: LOW - Mature but largely unmaintained. Good reference for event-driven patterns but superseded by more modern frameworks.

projects.name: Catalyst (Enigma)
projects.description: Algorithmic trading library for crypto assets built on top of Zipline. Supports backtesting and live trading on crypto exchanges.
projects.relevance: LOW - Largely abandoned. Interesting as a case study for adapting Zipline to crypto but not actively maintained.

projects.name: Zenbot
projects.description: Command-line crypto trading bot using Node.js. Supports multiple exchanges and includes various strategy templates.
projects.relevance: LOW - Node.js ecosystem. Interesting CLI UX patterns but limited relevance for our Python-first monorepo.

projects.name: Gekko
projects.description: Bitcoin trading bot framework. Deprecated but historically significant as one of the first open-source crypto trading bots.
projects.relevance: LOW - Deprecated. Good historical reference for trading bot UX patterns and plugin architecture but no longer maintained.

projects.name: CCXT
projects.description: CryptoCurrency eXchange Trading Library. Unified API for 100+ crypto exchanges supporting Python, JavaScript, and PHP.
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Essential exchange connectivity layer. Must be integrated as our exchange adapter foundation. Provides the unified API pattern we need for multi-exchange support.

projects.name: OctoBot
projects.description: Open source cryptocurrency trading bot with web interface. Supports tentacles (plugins) architecture and multiple trading modes.
key_features: Multiple trading modes (technical analysis, AI, social)
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Excellent plugin architecture (tentacles). Its evaluator chain pattern and trading mode abstraction inform our agent evaluation pipeline design.

projects.name: Backtesting.py
projects.description: Lightweight Python backtesting framework. Fast, intuitive backtesting with interactive Jupyter visualizations.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Lightweight alternative to heavier frameworks. Good for quick prototyping and its interactive viz is excellent for strategy development UX.

categories.name: AI/Agent Trading
categories.description: AI-powered trading systems and LLM-based agent frameworks for financial markets

projects.name: TradingAgents (Princeton)
projects.description: Multi-Agent LLM Financial Trading Framework from Princeton/Tauric Research. LLM-powered agents with specialized roles (analyst, trader, risk manager) that collaborate for trading decisions.
key_features: Specialized LLM agent roles (Analyst, Trader, Risk Manager)
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Directly maps to our multi-agent trading architecture. Its debate/consensus pattern for trading decisions and role-based agent design are core patterns to adopt.

projects.name: AI-Hedge-Fund
projects.description: AI-powered hedge fund proof of concept. Multiple AI agents (Warren Buffett, Bill Ackman style) analyze markets from different investment perspectives to make trading decisions.
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Most popular AI trading agent project. Its persona-based agent pattern and council voting mechanism directly inform our agent orchestration design.

projects.name: FinRobot
projects.description: Open-source AI Agent platform for financial analysis by AI4Finance. Multi-agent system with financial data fetching, LLM analysis, and report generation.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Strong multi-agent financial analysis pattern. Its tool-augmented reasoning and data pipeline inform our financial analysis agent design.

projects.name: FinGPT
projects.description: Open-source Financial Large Language Model. Fine-tuned LLM for financial NLP tasks including sentiment analysis, news classification, and trading signal generation.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Core financial NLP model. Its fine-tuning approach and financial NLP capabilities are essential for our sentiment analysis and news processing pipeline.

projects.name: BloombergGPT
projects.description: 50-billion parameter LLM specifically trained for finance by Bloomberg. Proprietary but represents the state-of-the-art in domain-specific financial LLMs.
key_features: Mixed financial and general data training
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Benchmark for financial LLM quality. While proprietary, its training methodology and benchmark results guide our FinGPT fine-tuning strategy.

projects.name: Portfoliopilot
projects.description: AI-powered portfolio management assistant. Uses LLMs for portfolio analysis, rebalancing suggestions, and risk assessment.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Good reference for LLM-based portfolio management. Its natural language query interface is relevant for our user interaction design.

projects.name: AutoTrader-AI
projects.description: AI-powered automated trading system. Uses machine learning models for stock prediction and automated trade execution.
projects.relevance: LOW - Smaller project but demonstrates ML prediction pipeline pattern useful as a reference.

projects.name: QuantGPT
projects.description: GPT-powered quantitative trading assistant. Uses LLMs for strategy generation, code writing, and market analysis.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Interesting LLM-as-coder pattern for strategy generation. Could inform our strategy generation agent.

projects.name: TradeAI
projects.description: AI-driven trading platform combining LLMs with traditional quantitative methods for multi-asset trading.
projects.relevance: LOW - Hybrid approach concept is relevant but project is too small for direct integration.

projects.name: Stock-Trading-Agent
projects.description: Reinforcement learning-based stock trading agent. Uses DRL algorithms for automated trading decisions.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Good reference for RL trading agent design. Its environment and reward function design patterns inform our RL module.

projects.name: AI4Finance
projects.description: Foundation developing AI tools for finance. Maintains FinRL, FinGPT, FinRobot, and other AI finance projects. Key ecosystem for AI-driven finance.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Core ecosystem. Their entire stack (FinRL + FinGPT + FinRobot) should be integrated into our platform as a cohesive AI finance layer.

projects.name: DeepTrader
projects.description: Deep learning-based trading system using transformer architectures for market prediction and portfolio optimization.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Transformer architecture for market prediction is cutting-edge. Its cross-asset attention design informs our multi-asset model architecture.

projects.name: FinRL (AI4Finance)
projects.description: Deep reinforcement learning framework for automated stock trading. First open-source framework for financial RL with SOTA DRL algorithms.
key_features: DRL algorithms (PPO, A2C, DDPG, TD3, SAC)
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Core DRL trading framework. Its gym-compatible environment design, multi-agent RL, and SOTA algorithm implementations are essential for our RL trading module.

projects.name: Intrinio AI Trading
projects.description: Financial data platform with NLP and AI capabilities. Provides structured financial data, real-time feeds, and NLP-processed news/sentiment data.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Data provider with NLP enrichment. Their sentiment and NLP data feeds complement our FinGPT-based analysis pipeline.

projects.name: Kensho (S&P Global)
projects.description: AI and analytics platform by S&P Global. Applies machine learning and NLP to financial data for predictive analytics and intelligent data extraction.
projects.relevance: LOW - Proprietary enterprise platform. Reference for large-scale financial AI architecture but not directly integrable.

projects.name: Alpha_Vantage_AI
projects.description: Python module for Alpha Vantage API with ML integration capabilities. Provides stock data, technical indicators, and crypto data for AI model training.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Data access layer for Alpha Vantage. Good pattern for building API wrappers in our data provider module.

categories.name: Factor/Alpha Libraries
categories.description: Factor investing, alpha generation, and risk model libraries

projects.name: WorldQuant Alpha101
projects.description: Code implementation of WorldQuant's 101 Formulaic Alphas. Systematic alpha factor library implementing the famous 101 alpha formulas.
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Foundation alpha factor library. Must be integrated into our factor computation engine. Provides the baseline alpha factors for our strategy development.

projects.name: WorldQuant BRAIN
projects.description: WorldQuant's BRAIN platform for alpha factor research and simulation. Crowd-sourced alpha discovery platform with simulation capabilities.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Reference for alpha evaluation methodology. Its simulation and scoring approach informs our alpha evaluation pipeline.

projects.name: GTJA191
projects.description: Implementation of Guotai Junan Securities' 191 alpha factors. Chinese quant factor library widely used in A-share market research.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Complements Alpha101 with additional factor formulas. Important for Asian market coverage and demonstrates factor validation methodology.

projects.name: Barra Risk Model
projects.description: Implementation of MSCI Barra multi-factor risk model. Industry standard for risk factor decomposition and portfolio risk analysis.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Industry standard risk model. Must implement Barra-style risk decomposition in our risk module. Essential for institutional-grade risk management.

projects.name: Alphalens (Quantopian)
projects.description: Performance analysis of predictive (alpha) stock factors. Quantopian's tool for analyzing alpha factors with IC, quantile returns, and turnover analysis.
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Standard tool for alpha factor evaluation. Must be integrated into our factor research pipeline. Its IC and quantile analysis are essential for alpha validation.

projects.name: Empyrical
projects.description: Common financial risk metrics. Library of widely-used risk and performance metrics for algorithmic trading strategy evaluation.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Core metrics library. Essential for our performance evaluation module. Provides all standard risk and return metrics we need.

projects.name: Pyfolio (Quantopian)
projects.description: Portfolio and risk analytics in Python. Generates comprehensive tear sheets for strategy performance analysis with Bayesian analysis.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Standard portfolio analytics tool. Its tear sheet pattern and Bayesian analysis inform our reporting and analytics module.

projects.name: Riskfolio-Lib
projects.description: Portfolio optimization and risk management library. Implements modern portfolio theory, risk parity, and advanced optimization methods.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Comprehensive portfolio optimization library. Complements PyPortfolioOpt with risk parity and HRP implementations. Essential for our portfolio construction module.

projects.name: Smart-Beta Framework
projects.description: Framework for smart beta and factor-based investing strategies. Implements various factor weighting and screening methodologies.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Good reference for factor-based portfolio construction. Its screening and weighting patterns inform our smart-beta strategy module.

projects.name: Toraniko
projects.description: Multi-factor equity risk model for quantitative trading. Complete implementation of a risk model suitable for institutional-scale systematic trading.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Complete Barra-style risk model implementation. Good reference for building our own risk model beyond the basic Barra implementation.

projects.name: AlphaTrading
projects.description: Multi-factor models implementation. Implements APT model, BARRA risk model, and dynamic multi-factor model for alpha generation.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Good multi-factor model reference. Its dynamic factor weighting and factor timing approaches are advanced patterns for our alpha library.

categories.name: Risk Management
categories.description: Risk measurement, portfolio optimization, and risk management libraries

projects.name: PyPortfolioOpt
projects.description: Financial portfolio optimization in Python. Implements mean-variance optimization, Black-Litterman, efficient frontier, and custom optimization.
architecture_patterns: Expected returns → Risk model → Optimizer pipeline
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Core portfolio optimization library. Its modular pipeline (expected returns → risk model → optimizer) should be our portfolio construction architecture.

projects.name: Skfolio
projects.description: Python library for portfolio optimization built on scikit-learn API. Provides cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, and pipeline composition for portfolios.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Novel scikit-learn integration for portfolio optimization. Its CV and pipeline patterns bring ML rigor to portfolio construction.

projects.name: Riskfolio-Lib
projects.description: Portfolio optimization library with extensive risk measures. Supports mean-risk optimization with 13 risk measures including CVaR, CDaR, and EVaR.
key_features: 13 risk measures (VaR, CVaR, CDaR, EVaR, etc.)
projects.relevance: HIGH - Most comprehensive risk measure library. Essential for our risk management module with its 13 risk measures and optimization methods.

projects.name: PyRisk
projects.description: Risk management library for VaR, CVaR, and Monte Carlo simulation. Provides parametric, historical, and Monte Carlo VaR computation.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Focused VaR/CVaR library. Good reference for our VaR computation module but limited scope.

projects.name: Kelly Criterion Library
projects.description: Implementation of Kelly Criterion for optimal position sizing. Computes optimal bet size based on win probability and payoff ratio.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Essential position sizing method. Kelly Criterion should be one of our position sizing options alongside risk parity and fixed-fractional.

projects.name: riskparity.py
projects.description: Python implementation of risk parity portfolio optimization. Solves the risk budgeting problem for equal risk contribution portfolios.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Focused risk parity implementation. Important for our risk parity allocation module.

projects.name: Monte Carlo Simulation Engine
projects.description: QuantStats: Portfolio analytics for quants. Includes Monte Carlo simulation, tear sheets, and comprehensive risk/performance metrics.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Professional analytics and reporting. Its tear sheet generation and Monte Carlo simulation are essential for our reporting module.

projects.name: Maximum Drawdown Analysis (ffn)
projects.description: Financial functions for Python. Provides performance measurement, drawdown analysis, and group statistics for financial data.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Lightweight performance/drawdown analysis. Useful utility library for our metrics computation.

projects.name: Stress-Testing Framework
projects.description: Scenario analysis and stress testing framework for portfolios. Simulates portfolio performance under various market stress scenarios.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Important for institutional risk management. Stress testing should be a key feature in our risk module.

projects.name: CVaR Portfolio Optimization
projects.description: CVaR-based portfolio optimization using Rockafellar-Uryasev transformation. Implements tail-risk-aware portfolio construction.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Specialized CVaR optimization. Good reference for implementing CVaR-based portfolio construction in our risk module.

categories.name: Data Providers
categories.description: Market data APIs, financial data providers, and data integration libraries

projects.name: Polygon.io
projects.description: Institutional-grade financial data platform. Provides real-time and historical market data for stocks, options, forex, and crypto via REST and WebSocket APIs.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Premium data provider. Should be our primary equity/options data source. WebSocket support enables real-time agent decision-making.

projects.name: Alpaca Markets
projects.description: Developer-first API for stock, options, and crypto trading. Commission-free trading API with market data included.
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Best trading API for US equities. Paper trading + live trading + data in one API. Essential for our execution and data modules.

projects.name: TwelveData
projects.description: Financial market data API. Real-time and historical data for stocks, forex, crypto, ETFs, and indices with 100+ technical indicators.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Good alternative data provider. Built-in technical indicators are useful. Can serve as backup data source.

projects.name: AlphaVantage
projects.description: Free stock APIs for realtime and historical equity data, forex, and crypto. Freemium model with generous free tier.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Good free-tier data provider. Useful for development and testing. Sentiment API adds NLP capability.

projects.name: Binance API
projects.description: World's largest crypto exchange API. REST and WebSocket APIs for spot, margin, futures, and options trading.
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Primary crypto exchange API. Must integrate for our crypto trading. Testnet enables risk-free testing.

projects.name: Bybit API
projects.description: Cryptocurrency derivatives exchange API. Supports spot, linear/inverse futures, and options with high-performance trading infrastructure.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Major crypto derivatives exchange. Important for our crypto derivatives trading capabilities.

projects.name: CoinGecko
projects.description: Comprehensive cryptocurrency data API. Market data, pricing, volume, market cap for 10,000+ cryptocurrencies.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Best crypto market data aggregator. Essential for crypto market overview and token discovery.

projects.name: Yahoo Finance (yfinance)
projects.description: Download market data from Yahoo Finance. Popular Python library for free stock market data download.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Most popular free stock data source. Essential for development, backtesting, and as a fallback data source.

projects.name: SEC EDGAR
projects.description: SEC EDGAR filing system. Free access to corporate filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, etc.) for fundamental analysis.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Essential for fundamental analysis. SEC filing data feeds our fundamental analysis agent.

projects.name: FRED (Federal Reserve)
projects.description: Federal Reserve Economic Data. 800,000+ US and international economic time series from 100+ sources.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Essential macroeconomic data. FRED data feeds our macro analysis agent and risk scenario modeling.

projects.name: Quandl/Nasdaq Data Link
projects.description: Financial, economic, and alternative data platform. Wide range of premium and free datasets via unified API.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Diverse financial data source. Useful for specialized datasets and alternative data access.

projects.name: Tiingo
projects.description: Financial data platform with institutional-grade data. Provides end-of-day, intraday, and real-time data with Python/REST API.
projects.relevance: LOW - Niche data provider. Good alternative source but not primary.

projects.name: IEX Cloud
projects.description: Financial data platform. Real-time and historical stock market data with simple API and Apperate data platform.
projects.relevance: LOW - Alternative data provider. Useful as backup but pricing can be complex.

categories.name: Agent Frameworks
categories.description: AI agent frameworks and multi-agent orchestration platforms

projects.name: LangGraph
projects.description: Framework for building resilient agent workflows as graphs. Low-level orchestration for stateful, long-running multi-agent systems.
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Core agent orchestration framework. Must be our primary agent workflow engine. Graph-based model perfectly fits our multi-agent trading system.

projects.name: CrewAI
projects.description: Framework for orchestrating role-playing AI agents. Lean, fast Python framework for multi-agent collaboration with defined roles and tasks.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Intuitive multi-agent framework. Its Crew-Agent-Task model is a great pattern for our trading crew (analyst, trader, risk manager). Complements LangGraph.

projects.name: AutoGen (Microsoft)
projects.description: Framework for creating multi-agent AI applications. Supports autonomous and human-in-the-loop agent collaboration with conversation patterns.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Major multi-agent framework. Its conversation patterns and group chat orchestration inform our agent communication design. Now split into AutoGen and AG2.

projects.name: OpenManus
projects.description: Open-source framework for building AI agents. Provides essential capabilities for building, running, and managing AI agents with RL-based tuning.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Emerging agent framework. Its RL-based tuning approach could optimize our trading agent performance over time.

projects.name: PydanticAI
projects.description: AI Agent framework, the Pydantic way. Type-safe agent framework with structured output validation and dependency injection.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Type-safe agent framework. Critical for our production system - Pydantic validation ensures agent outputs are well-formed. Perfect for financial data validation.

projects.name: DSPy
projects.description: Framework for programming—not prompting—language models. Declarative approach to LM programming with automatic prompt optimization.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Paradigm-shifting LM framework. Its signature-based approach and automatic optimization could dramatically improve our trading agent quality without manual prompt engineering.

projects.name: SmolAgents (HuggingFace)
projects.description: Lightweight agent framework by HuggingFace. Minimal, simple agents that can use tools with code generation capabilities.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Lightweight agent pattern. Good for simple tool-calling agents in our system. HuggingFace integration enables model flexibility.

projects.name: Agno
projects.description: SDK for building agent platforms. High-performance runtime for multi-agent systems with model-agnostic design.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - High-performance agent runtime. Its model-agnostic design and performance focus are relevant for our production agent runtime.

projects.name: LlamaIndex
projects.description: Data framework for LLM applications. Leading document agent framework with RAG pipelines, data connectors, and agentic RAG.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Essential RAG framework. Critical for our financial document analysis (SEC filings, earnings reports). Its data connector ecosystem is invaluable.

projects.name: Haystack (deepset)
projects.description: Open-source AI orchestration framework for production-ready LLM applications. RAG, search, and agent pipelines.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Alternative RAG framework. Its pipeline component model and evaluation framework provide good patterns for our financial RAG pipeline.

projects.name: Semantic Kernel (Microsoft)
projects.description: Model-agnostic SDK for building AI agents. Integrates cutting-edge LLM technology with conventional programming languages.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Enterprise agent SDK. Its planner pattern for automatic orchestration and plugin architecture inform our modular agent design.

categories.name: LangGraph Patterns
categories.description: Design patterns and architectural approaches for LangGraph-based trading systems

projects.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration
projects.description: LangGraph pattern for coordinating multiple agents in a hierarchical or peer-to-peer structure. Supervisor and swarm patterns for agent delegation.
architecture_patterns: Conditional routing based on agent output
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Core pattern for our trading system. Supervisor pattern maps to our portfolio manager → analyst/trader/risk manager hierarchy.

projects.name: Graph-Based Workflows
projects.description: LangGraph's core graph abstraction for defining agent workflows as directed graphs with conditional edges and cycles.
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Foundation pattern. Our entire trading workflow (data → analysis → decision → execution → risk check) is a graph with conditional routing.

projects.name: State Machine Patterns
projects.description: Using LangGraph for finite state machine patterns. ReAct agent as a state machine with observe-think-act cycles.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Trading agent state machine. Each trading agent follows observe (market data) → think (analysis) → act (trade) → verify (risk check) cycle.

projects.name: Council/Voting Patterns
projects.description: Multi-agent collaboration where agents vote or reach consensus on decisions. Democratic or weighted voting for trading decisions.
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Core trading decision pattern. Multiple agents (bull, bear, risk) vote on trade decisions with weighted confidence scores.

projects.name: Tool-Calling Patterns
projects.description: LangGraph integration with LLM tool calling. Agents use structured tools for market data, order placement, and analysis.
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Essential for trading tools. Our agents call tools for market data, order placement, risk calculation, and notification.

projects.name: Memory Management
projects.description: LangGraph's memory and checkpointing system for persistent state across agent runs. Short-term and long-term memory patterns.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Critical for trading continuity. Agents need memory of past trades, market conditions, and strategy performance across sessions.

projects.name: Human-in-the-Loop
projects.description: LangGraph pattern for inserting human approval and feedback into agent workflows. Interrupt before critical actions.
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Safety mechanism for trading. Human approval required before executing trades above threshold. Interrupt before order placement for review.

projects.name: Subgraph Composition
projects.description: Pattern for composing LangGraph subgraphs into larger workflows. Enables modular agent system design.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Modular architecture pattern. Each trading domain (analysis, execution, risk) can be a subgraph composed into the main trading workflow.

projects.name: Parallel Execution
projects.description: Pattern for parallel fan-out and fan-in of agent tasks. Multiple agents analyze simultaneously and results are aggregated.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Performance pattern. Multiple analysis agents run in parallel (technical, fundamental, sentiment) and results are aggregated for decision.

projects.name: Self-Correcting Agents
projects.description: Pattern for agents that detect and correct their own errors. Retry with reflection on failures for improved accuracy.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Robustness pattern. Trading agents validate their outputs (position sizes, risk limits) and self-correct before execution.

categories.name: Execution Systems
categories.description: Order management, smart routing, and trade execution infrastructure

projects.name: NautilusTrader OMS
projects.description: Built-in order management system within NautilusTrader. Production-grade OMS with full lifecycle management for multi-venue trading.
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Best open-source OMS. Its actor-based order management and venue adapter pattern are the gold standard for our execution module.

projects.name: Lean Engine Execution
projects.description: QuantConnect's execution module. Transaction handler pipeline for order routing, fill simulation, and brokerage integration.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Enterprise execution reference. Its transaction handler pipeline and brokerage abstraction should inform our execution architecture.

projects.name: CCXT Pro Execution
projects.description: CCXT's unified trading API with order placement, management, and exchange-specific adaptations across 100+ exchanges.
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Exchange connectivity layer. Must integrate for multi-exchange order management. Its adapter pattern is the foundation of our exchange module.

projects.name: Freqtrade Execution
projects.description: Freqtrade's execution module with exchange integration, order management, and dry-run simulation.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Proven execution in production. Its dry-run simulation and order timeout patterns are essential for safe trading execution.

projects.name: Hummingbot Connector Architecture
projects.description: Hummingbot's connector framework for exchange and protocol integration. Gateway architecture for CEX and DEX connectivity.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Best connector architecture. Its gateway pattern for DEX and rate-limit-aware scheduling are critical for our exchange module.

projects.name: Alpaca Trading API
projects.description: Developer-friendly equity trading API. Paper and live trading with order management, position tracking, and smart order routing.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Best equity trading API. Paper trading environment is perfect for testing. Smart order routing and bracket orders are essential features.

projects.name: Smart Order Router (SOR)
projects.description: Order routing logic across multiple venues for best execution. Price discovery and splitting across exchanges.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Advanced execution feature. Smart order routing is a future enhancement for our execution module.

projects.name: Slippage Models
projects.description: Zipline's slippage model implementations. Volume share slippage and fixed slippage models for realistic backtesting.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Essential for realistic backtesting. Slippage modeling ensures our backtested performance reflects real-world execution.

projects.name: Fill Simulation Engine
projects.description: NautilusTrader's order fill simulation with order book depth modeling and realistic execution simulation.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Best fill simulation. Order book depth modeling and latency simulation are critical for realistic backtesting.

projects.name: Paper Trading Framework
projects.description: QuantConnect's paper trading brokerages. Simulated brokerage environments for testing strategies without real capital.
architecture_patterns: Same API for paper and live
projects.relevance: HIGH - Essential testing infrastructure. Paper trading with real-time data is critical before live deployment.

projects.name: Interactive Brokers TWS API
projects.description: Interactive Brokers trading API. Professional-grade order management and execution for global markets.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Professional broker integration. IBKR support extends our platform to global equities, futures, and options markets.

categories.name: Prediction Markets
categories.description: Prediction market platforms and APIs for event-driven trading signals

projects.name: Polymarket
projects.description: Largest crypto prediction market. CLOB-based trading on real-world events with transparent order books and API access.
key_features: API for market data and trading
projects.relevance: HIGH - Primary prediction market. Event probability data provides unique trading signals. API integration enables automated trading on event outcomes.

projects.name: Kalshi
projects.description: CFTC-regulated prediction market for US events. Legal US trading on economic data, elections, weather, and more.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Regulated prediction market. Economic event contracts provide unique alpha signals. Regulatory compliance enables institutional use.

projects.name: Metaculus
projects.description: Community prediction platform for forecasting real-world events. Aggregated human forecasts with accuracy tracking.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Complementary signal source. Aggregated human forecasts provide sentiment-like signals for event-driven trading strategies.

projects.name: Augur
projects.description: Decentralized prediction market on Ethereum. Anyone can create markets for any event with trustless settlement.
projects.relevance: LOW - Decentralized alternative. Interesting for unbanked markets but lower liquidity and UX compared to Polymarket/Kalshi.

projects.name: Manifold Markets
projects.description: Social prediction market platform. Play-money prediction markets with community-driven forecasting.
projects.relevance: LOW - Niche forecasting platform. Useful for sentiment data but not suitable for real-money trading integration.

categories.name: Backtesting Engines
categories.description: Backtesting frameworks, simulation engines, and strategy evaluation tools

projects.name: VectorBT Pro
projects.description: Vectorized backtesting engine using NumPy/Numba. 10-100x faster than event-driven backtests for signal-based strategies.
projects.relevance: CRITICAL - Fast backtesting engine. Essential for rapid strategy prototyping and parameter optimization. Should be our primary fast-backtest module.

projects.name: Backtrader Event Engine
projects.description: Classic event-driven backtesting engine. Simulates real-time bar delivery to strategies with full broker simulation.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Classic event-driven reference. Its Cerebro pattern and observer/Analyzer system inform our event-driven backtesting design.

projects.name: Zipline Reloaded
projects.description: Community-maintained Zipline with updated dependencies. Event-driven backtesting with Pipeline API for factor computation.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Maintained Zipline fork. Pipeline API is the gold standard for factor computation and should influence our factor library design.

projects.name: NautilusTrader Backtest
projects.description: NautilusTrader's backtesting module. Production-grade backtesting with order book simulation and realistic fill modeling.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Most realistic backtesting. Order book simulation and tick-level resolution provide the most accurate backtesting for our production strategies.

projects.name: Backtesting.py
projects.description: Lightweight backtesting with interactive HTML visualizations. Simple API for quick strategy validation.
projects.relevance: MEDIUM - Quick validation tool. Perfect for rapid prototyping and its HTML visualization is excellent for strategy development.

projects.name: Walk-Forward Optimization
projects.description: Walk-forward analysis pattern for robust strategy optimization. Rolling window train-test to avoid overfitting.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Essential for strategy robustness. Walk-forward optimization must be integrated to prevent overfitting in our strategy evaluation pipeline.

projects.name: Monte Carlo Backtesting
projects.description: Monte Carlo simulation for strategy stress testing. Randomized trade order and return resampling for confidence intervals.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Strategy robustness testing. Monte Carlo simulation provides confidence intervals for strategy performance metrics.

projects.name: Lean Engine Backtesting
projects.description: QuantConnect's cloud-scale backtesting engine. Supports massive universe selection and tick-level resolution.
projects.relevance: HIGH - Enterprise backtesting. Its Alpha → Portfolio → Risk → Execution pipeline is the reference architecture for our trading system.

projects.name: FinRL Backtesting
projects.description: FinRL's backtesting integration with DRL agents. Gym-compatible environment evaluation with realistic market simulation.
projects.relevance: HIGH - DRL backtesting. Essential for evaluating our reinforcement learning trading agents with realistic market simulation.

projects.name: Qlib Backtesting
projects.description: Qlib's backtesting and evaluation module. Integrated with ML models for end-to-end strategy evaluation.
projects.relevance: HIGH - ML-integrated backtesting. Its model → signal → strategy → backtest pipeline is exactly how our ML trading pipeline should work.
